optimizedContext.value:
# GetStatus
## Rules
- Input `name`, optional `refreshImplementationTracking` default true active only, optional `ifModifiedSince` parsed `Date.parse`. Resolve `changes.get(name)`, then `getDraft(name)`; else `ChangeNotFoundError` code `CHANGE_NOT_FOUND`; never `getDiscarded`.
- Valid `ifModifiedSince >= change.updatedAt.getTime()` short-circuits: no refresh/full projection/review/blocker recompute; return `unchanged: true`, loaded change, `specDependsOn`, empty `artifactStatuses`/blockers; review/nextAction minimal allowed. Omitted/invalid/older: full path.
- Result active `change` or draft-only `draftView`, artifacts, dependencies, review, blockers, nextAction; implementation tracked files/review states + file/symbol links. Draft conforms `core:drafted-change-view`: `projectArtifacts` only, no `evaluateLifecycle`/`evaluateLifecycleVerdict`; no mutable `Change`, transitions/steps empty, `nextArtifact=null`, no transition/validate command.
- Full active path refreshes `RefreshImplementationTracking.execute({ name })` unless refresh false or conditional current; reload afterward. No `ImplementationDetector`/duplicate merge.
- Full path exactly one entry/schema artifact, missing unattached types; derive effective status by `evaluateLifecycle`/`projectArtifacts`, recursive dependencies/workflow/gates. Preserve canonical state/effectiveStatus; file `hasDrift`, `displayStatus`; `complete-with-drift` only complete+drift; real states outrank display drift.
- Task artifact (`hasTasks` + `taskCompletionCheck`): reuse `workflow.taskCompletion` `CountTasks` pass result by type; optional `{ complete, incomplete, total }`; missing/empty omits. Evaluation-pass memoization only.
- For protocol-legal targets execute every matching binding predicate; at `archivable` run archive predicates with allow flags false; no hook effects. `evaluateLifecycle` produces transitions/steps/nextAction/check rows; no command from domain `nextHop`; checks own I/O, no global snapshot.
- Review priority: `drifted-pending-review` → `artifact-drift`; else pending + unhandled overlap → `spec-overlap-conflict`; else pending → `artifact-review-required`; else none. Required route designing with human message. Unhandled overlaps: reverse history, collect invalidated `spec-overlap-conflict`, stop first transitioned `to !== designing`; newest-first `overlapDetail`; victim never public `OVERLAP_CONFLICT`/`--allow-overlap`.
- Blockers: review `ARTIFACT_DRIFT`/`REVIEW_REQUIRED`; every failed candidate check, including `INCOMPLETE_ARTIFACT`, approvals/tasks/deps/read-only/implementation/invalid transition/archive. `OVERLAP_CONFLICT` only live archive predicate while archivable; maintain `/specd-archive`, target archivable, reason mentions live overlap/`--allow-overlap`. Check blockers include `label`, preferably `checkId`; `--allow-out-of-scope` only `impl.linksInScope`, never `impl.filesResolved`.
- Constructor: changes, schemaProvider, approvals, refresh primitive, composed transition/archive checks/bindings; import module `evaluateLifecycle`; no `LifecycleEngine`, `CountTasks`, `ImplementationDetector`. Config factory preserves canonical bootstrap via `resolveGetStatusDeps(resolver)` then canonical factory.
- `SchemaProvider.get()` `SchemaNotFoundError` degrades silently: static transitions, no available transitions/blockers, approvals, `nextArtifact=null`, normal changePath, `schemaInfo=null`; other errors/check failures propagate. `changePath = ChangeRepository.changePath(change)`.
## Constraints
- Read-only.
- No artifact-content read except matching check; never CountTasks twice.
- Lifecycle domain projection I/O-free.
